description:
Removes webhooks by ID. Only webhooks registered by the calling app are removed. If webhooks created by other apps are specified, they are ignored.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Only [Connect](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/#connect-apps) and [OAuth 2.0](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/oauth-2-3lo-apps) apps can use this operation.

202.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the list of webhook IDs is missing.

403.description: Returned if the caller isn't an app.
